answer: Give every agent a kernel: a cipher chain that deepens only through its own completed work. Each finished job seals the next link with a key derived from the previous job output, and each link adds a unique pigment to the chain, darkening as the kernel grows. Earning unlocks only at depth, so a farm cannot share one kernel across fakes, cannot parallelize a chain where each link depends on the last, and cannot bulk-buy depth that only real sequential work creates.
